items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You mentioned the other day something about Turo and Dolphin, or wait a minute. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Turo and Dolphin. Schoolhouse.

ctx.x: No, that's the same place. That's the same as the other one on Dolphin.
Oh, no, Dolphin. Well, you didn't go down on Mandeville and Ramport.
No. Let me make a note of that again. Mandeville. What tall is that?
